importance: Annual grand 13-day festival of Sri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy and Sri Venkateswara Swamy held on the banks of Godavari in Dharmapuri
description: The peak annual celebration where tens of thousands of devotees gather. Involves celestial wedding (Kalyanotsavam), processions, Teppotsavam, Rathotsavam, Chakratirtham, Pushpayagam, and stage plays by Laxmi Narasimha Natya Mandali. During this period, Nithya Kalyanam and Nitya Nrusimha Homams are suspended.

month: 26 June 2027 – 7 July 2027 (12 days Adi Pushkarams); Anthya Pushkarams: 13 July 2028 – 24 July 2028
importance: Major 12-year astrological river festival when Jupiter (Guru) enters Simha (Leo), charging Godavari with divine energy
description: Millions of pilgrims gather at Dakshina Vahini Godavari banks for Pushkara Snanam (holy dip, especially Arunodaya Snanam at dawn), Pinda Pradaanam (ancestral rites), Pitru Tarpanam (water offerings with sesame seeds), and Daanam & Dharma (charity). Transit Muhurtham starts on 26 June 2027 at approx 05:25 AM IST.

schedule.details: Start of Adi Pushkarams as Jupiter enters Simha (Leo). Sacred bath (Arunodaya Snanam) commences.
Daily Pushkara Snanam, Pinda Pradaanam, Pitru Tarpanam, and Daanam & Dharma.
Final sacred 12 days of the 12-year Jupiter cycle.

description: Devotional plays and special ceremonies performed by Laxmi Narasimha Natya Mandali during the nine nights of Narasimha worship.

importance: Holy Hindu month for lighting lamps
description: Thousands of devotees arrive daily to light lamps (Akasha Deepam) along the Godavari river bank.
Tens of thousands of devotees pack the temple and river banks celebrating the Hari-Hara tradition.
High-volume festive day with heavy surge of devotees at the temple.
Major festive day drawing large crowds for special darshan.
